## T43 publication storage clarification — 2026-11-02

The reported normal-hook refusal is the same known public SM6115 filename class already handled in the immutable seed's T43 proof. The existing precedent is `docs/qa-logs/2026-11-02-m6-resume/t43-brief-proof/exact-storage.json` at coordinator `92e8d07b6163ec5ddd3e9b67f1c42a472b2911d1`: it distinguishes original/decoded bytes from stored JSON bytes and preserves every original receipt hash.

Within the existing A–D records-only dispatch, use that **lossless storage representation for this exact known filename only**. Preserve the original normal-hook refusal. Keep all432 actual source keys/modes/blobs, original program/input/output identities,779 call records and raw producer hashes. JSON string escaping of the one hyphen must decode to exactly the original string; if an affected raw text receipt needs an envelope, retain its original path, encoding, complete decoded bytes and original SHA256, plus a separate stored-file hash and explicit restoration rule. Do not relabel the stored-byte hash as the old raw hash.

A new audit-local storage/reader check may verify the round trip and complete manifest, with a tampered/missing-payload refusal and positive. This is a metadata custody check, not permission to rerun or alter any application, source extraction, historical control or producer. Leave original producer programs unchanged; any new decoder is separately named. Human tables may label the escaped display, but their decoded machine keys remain the exact source paths. Do not hide or drop an affected row or output.

Run the normal record gates and normal hooks after the representation change. No hook/pattern bypass, secret substitution, product/source edit, blanket exemption or unrelated normalization. If a different filename/content class is refused, or exact round-trip identities cannot be preserved, return that precise blocker. Publication remains the clean Stage-D stop; this comment does not accept D or select PL-001's outcome. Root will read the published packet, including storage identities, before disposition.
